summary: This TypeScript module integrates Bluesky social media engagement data into a Docusaurus blog. It fetches likes, reposts, and comments for blog posts, manages caching in sessionStorage to avoid repeated API calls, and filters out blocked accounts. The main export is a React hook that returns engagement statistics for display in the blog UI.
